tasks.goal: Fix the two pre-scan defects recorded by T040 (both proven fold-independent with byte-identical artifacts under the fold switch): (1) GRID-MODEL BAKING DEFECT (correctness-critical): chunk_gdn2_fwd_kernel_inter_solve_fused bakes a case-tier launch geometry into a shape-independent cache key — the [17] float32 case folds the grid axis to the constant 4 (case-layer literals B=2, H=2 of that shape's builder) while the same identity's [3,17,2,7,6] case correctly ties the axis to bundle view extents; both compiles share cache key 020c5b09... but produce different executables, and the [17]-compiled artifact leaves (b,h)-blocks >= 4 uncomputed at the larger shape (Akk output 0.0 vs reference 1.0). General fix in the grid model / specialization: a grid axis may fold to a compile-time constant only when the constant is identity-stable — derived exclusively from identity-keyed values (constexprs/meta, pointer dtypes), never from case-tier locals whose values vary across the SHAPES table of one identity; when stability cannot be proven, the axis must tie to a bundle-visible quantity or the operator refuses with a located diagnostic (never a silent fold). Add the regression: compile both shapes of the gdn2 identity in separate processes and assert either one shared correct artifact or two distinct keys, and the [3,17,2,7] execution compares PASS against the reference under both compile orders. (2) HARNESS DEFECT: tools/run_scan.py resource-evidence capture passes a counts.json path containing the case id (shape lists with commas) through QEMU's '-plugin file,out=PATH', which QEMU splits on commas (a truncated file 'suite__dev__op.py#[2' is created) so resource-flagged multi-dim-shape cases record LAUNCH_FAIL; fix with a comma-free evidence path (or escaping) and verify chunk_abc [2,2,17,9,8,4]#float16 records its resource evidence and passes. Then re-take the full cold compile census at the new revision (chunked or cache-warm as needed to survive the environment's background-task limit) and record it to docs/compiler-agent/COMPILE_CENSUS.json: every one of the 2116 identities an ELF artifact or a justified located refusal, zero unjustified refusals, zero crashes.
outputs: Identity-stable grid folding and fixed resource-evidence paths with regression tests; refreshed full compile census
acceptance: The gdn2 baking defect is fixed generically: grid-axis constants fold only from identity-stable values; the regression test compiles both shapes of the identity in separate fresh processes and asserts no wrong-artifact reuse (one correct shared artifact, or distinct keys), and the [3,17,2,7] case compares PASS under both compile orders; a non-identity-stable literal axis that cannot tie to the bundle produces a located refusal in the control test, never a silent fold.

The resource-evidence capture path is comma-safe: the chunk_abc [2,2,17,9,8,4]#float16 resource-flagged case records its evidence and executes/compares PASS (no LAUNCH_FAIL), and a comma-containing case id round-trips through the QEMU plugin argument.

A fresh full compile census at the new revision is recorded to docs/compiler-agent/COMPILE_CENSUS.json covering all 2116 identities: artifacts + justified located refusals sum to the census, zero unjustified refusals, zero crashes, compile count within the identity economics.
All pre-existing test files still pass.
